properties.notes: B/18/0059 Listed Building Consent for Listed building consent for single storey extension and refurbishment of 4 Wide Bargate. Demolition of part of the boundary wall to the Methodist Church and replacement with realigned wall and railings including pedestrian gate. The site is for sale.. Demolition of 36 Strait Bargate and 2 Wide Bargate and part of the boundary wall to the Methodist Church. Refurbishment and extension of Grade II listed 4 Wide Bargate. Erection of 14 no. retail units (A1); 2 no. retail units (A3/A5); and 15 no. residential apartments, with associated car parking. Creation of a new pedestrian (and delivery/service vehicle) link connecting Wide Bargate to Red Lion Street
